paper_facing_name: Hierarchical Move-Blocked Mixed-Integer MPC with Causal Domain Reduction

decisions: queued-job start block, rack, and IDC placement

resident_job_slots.growth: Per-method geometric growth to the next power of two when the visible causal queue exceeds the resident frontier
resident_job_slots.reuse: A grown model is reused for every later issue of that method; growth never drops or hides queued work

queued_dataset_residency.checkpoint_separation: The engineering checkpoint payload applies only to migration of an already-running job, never to queued-job placement

slow_master.circle_role: polyhedral lower-bound/screening model; never a physical commit authority
slow_master.exact_forced_domain_rule: Skip the MILP only when every retained slow decision has exactly one feasible option

fast_recourse.charge_discharge_exclusivity_recovery: If the relaxed convex-QCP incumbent exceeds the frozen 1e-4 kW simultaneous charge/discharge gate, fix every five-minute dispatch direction from incumbent net power and re-solve all lexicographic priorities inside the original watchdog; never widen the gate or commit the relaxed incumbent.
exact_constraints: fixed slow-decision GPU, rack, IDC, WAN, checkpoint, and deadline feasibility
fast_recourse.acceptance: Exact dimensionless QCP residual at the frozen scale-aware numerical tolerance, explicit engineering headroom inside every physical nameplate, and no simultaneous charge/discharge

lexicographic_objectives: min sum_h z_h * delta_t subject to priority 1
min secondary actuation subject to priorities 1 and 2
unchanged_scientific_semantics: voltage, line, transformer, SOC, PCS, mobility, GPU, rack, IDC, WAN, checkpoint, deadline, and recovery constraints
Fresh exact three-phase OpenDSS commit gate
online_commit_chain: bounded 9-stage slow MILP master or exact forced-domain skip
fixed-slow-decision exact H54 continuous QCP recourse

watchdog.stage_allocation: One shared 60-second planner deadline with no stage sub-deadlines. The slow master sees the total remaining deadline; exact recourse receives exactly the wall time left after the master and fixed-decision transfer. Fail closed only when the combined stages exhaust the watchdog.
watchdog.shared_deadline_evidence: R6 issue 1424 failed at the former master partition; R8 issue 1705 then failed at a nominal 20-second master reserve while issue 1704 measured master 16.03 s plus exact recourse 5.16 s, only 22.01 s total. R9 removed stage partitions and proved the combined master-plus-recourse solve itself exceeded 30 seconds. Therefore 30 seconds was a performance target masquerading as a fail-close watchdog, not a defensible physical deadline.
watchdog.watchdog_margin: The 60-second watchdog is one fifth of the physical five-minute control interval, retaining 240 seconds for downstream exact AC, storage, and actuation while allowing January to measure the hard-instance tail. Normal solves terminate at optimality and do not consume the unused allowance.
watchdog.r6_root_cause: The former fixed 55/45 split stopped issue 1424 at the master's 16.5-second sub-deadline even though issue 1423 completed master plus exact recourse in 20.99 seconds and the unchanged total watchdog was 30 seconds.
watchdog.production_freeze_rule: After January development, set the production watchdog from the measured steady-state p99 plus a documented margin; do not use the runtime performance target itself as the timeout
watchdog.semantics: Fail closed on timeout; never relax an objective priority or hard constraint

runtime_acceptance.comparison_scope: Same issue, state, forecast, candidate K, objective, hard constraints, Fresh OpenDSS gate, and storage path; worker/thread topology may vary because it is the measured factor
runtime_acceptance.measured_quantity: End-to-end total issue wall time, with component timings retained
runtime_acceptance.rule: A computational alternative with no paired speed improvement is removed from the production path

approved_solver_runtime_settings.exact_qcp_constraint_scaling: Every line, service-transformer, and PCS P-Q circle is divided by its physical nameplate before squaring, producing a dimensionless O(1) QCP row whose numerical residual is independent of equipment rating.
approved_solver_runtime_settings.norm_safety_invariant: The paper-facing stress objective remains normalized to physical nameplate. A separate zmax hard cap and PCS hard circle reserve an engineering margin ten times the scale-aware numerical tolerance; even an accepted solution at the positive residual boundary remains strictly inside nameplate because (1 - 1e-5) + 1e-6 < 1.
approved_solver_runtime_settings.exact_qcp_physical_feasibility_restorati: If independent scale-aware evaluation of either the stress row or the nameplate-safety row exceeds the frozen relative gate, add only supporting tangent half-spaces implied by the same Euclidean circles and re-solve every lexicographic priority; no gate or safe-limit relaxation is permitted.
approved_solver_runtime_settings.exact_qcp_restoration_solver_policy: Restoration-only reoptimization uses NumericFocus=3 and Crossover=0 to avoid a degenerate crossover basis after implied tangent insertion, then immediately restores the approved online NumericFocus=2 and AUTO crossover settings.
approved_solver_runtime_settings.numeric_focus_evidence: Paired 19-step B06 validation reduced steady end-to-end median and p95 with identical route decisions, predicted objectives, Fresh-AC values, zero exact residual, and AC PASS. NumericFocus 0 and 1 remain prohibited for exact recourse after clean reruns exceeded the frozen simultaneous charge/discharge residual tolerance

rejected_diagnostics: 54-step exact-cut MILP outer approximation: no primary convergence within 120 seconds
persistent sequential lexicographic QCP: slower than native multiobjective
condensed QCP diagnostic: objective and Fresh-AC trajectory mismatch
bounded topology diagnostics selected six day processes with two Gurobi threads each over arbitrary 4x4, 5x3, 7x2, and unpinned alternatives
exact-recourse NumericFocus=0 diagnostic: faster but failed a clean default rerun at the frozen charge/discharge residual tolerance
exact-recourse NumericFocus=1 diagnostic: failed the same frozen charge/discharge residual tolerance
Crossover=0 diagnostic: identical output but slower median and p95
MultiObjPre=2 diagnostic: identical output but slower median and p95
